citations.A1: Module-level cache is never invalidated — fix: check file mtime/hash each call and reload if changed
citations.A2: a TTL still serves stale data between polls and adds unnecessary latency; only a change-detection or explicit invalidation actually addresses staleness
citations.A3: Tempting fix "remove caching entirely, read the file every call" fixes staleness but reintroduces the I/O-per-call cost the cache existed for
citations.A4: Cache is a global singleton shared across all `path` arguments — fix: key the cache dict by `path`
